_comment: Edit 'enabled' to turn sources on or off. Run `python -m vcdiscovery.cli check-sources` to test each URL before relying on it.

sources.name: Hacker News (Show HN / Launch HN)
sources.access_notes: Free public API, no key. Run by Algolia for HN. Only titles, links and point counts are stored.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR Form D
sources.access_notes: Free public data. SEC requires a User-Agent with your name and email and max 10 requests/second (https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data).

sources.name: Wikidata (company facts)
sources.access_notes: Official MediaWiki API; data is public domain (CC0). Fills missing website, founding year, founders, HQ, industry and description for companies already discovered. Never overwrites existing values.

sources.name: TechCrunch: Funding tag
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed. Headlines, links and short summaries only.

sources.name: TechCrunch: Venture
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed. Headlines, links and short summaries only.

sources.name: TechCrunch: Startups
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed. Headlines, links and short summaries only.

sources.name: Crunchbase News
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed of free articles. The Crunchbase database itself is a paid product and is NOT accessed.

sources.name: FinSMEs
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed. Very high volume of funding headlines.
sources.disabled_reason: FinSMEs refused automated access (HTTP 403, first live run on 2026-10-08). Left off to respect the site's access rules; do not try to bypass it.

sources.name: EU-Startups
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed.

sources.name: VentureBeat
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed. Mostly AI/enterprise news; fewer funding headlines.
sources.disabled_reason: VentureBeat rate-limited automated requests (HTTP 429 after retries, first live run on 2026-10-08). Left off; TechCrunch and other feeds cover the same funding news. Re-test later with check-sources.

sources.name: PR Newswire: Venture Capital
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feed of press releases. Press releases are company statements (labelled company_announced).

sources.name: Sifted
sources.disabled_reason: Feed URL not confirmed. Run check-sources with --include-disabled; enable only if it returns a public feed. Most Sifted articles are paywalled; only feed headlines may be used.
sources.access_notes: Do not fetch paywalled article pages.

sources.name: Business Wire
sources.disabled_reason: Business Wire feed URLs are generated per topic on businesswire.com (RSS feeds page). Replace this URL with the feed you choose, then enable.
sources.access_notes: Public RSS feeds offered by Business Wire.

sources.name: Product Hunt
sources.disabled_reason: Requires a developer token, and Product Hunt's API terms restrict commercial use. Phase 4: add after reviewing the terms.
sources.access_notes: Do not scrape producthunt.com pages.

sources.name: Reddit (startup subreddits)
sources.access_notes: Official Reddit Data API, read-only application access. Stores titles, links, scores and comment counts only (no post text, no usernames); posts deleted on Reddit are removed on the next run. Links posts to companies already tracked; never creates new companies.

sources.name: YouTube: Y Combinator
sources.access_notes: Public YouTube channel feed (no key). Video titles, links and short descriptions only; videos are never downloaded. Funding news in titles is labelled like a news report.

sources.name: YouTube: TechCrunch
sources.access_notes: Public YouTube channel feed (no key). Video titles, links and short descriptions only; videos are never downloaded. Funding news in titles is labelled like a news report.

sources.name: YouTube: This Week in Startups

sources.name: YouTube: CNBC Television
sources.access_notes: Public YouTube channel feed (no key). Video titles, links and short descriptions only; videos are never downloaded. Funding news in titles is labelled like a news report.

sources.name: YouTube search (startup funding videos)
sources.access_notes: Official YouTube Data API v3 with a free key (4 searches a day, 400 of 10,000 free quota units). Stores titles, links, channel names and short descriptions only, and deletes them after 30 days (YouTube API policy). Links videos to companies already tracked; never creates new companies. Uses YouTube API Services: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms
sources.disabled_reason: Optional, off: needs a free Google Cloud API key (YOUTUBE_API_KEY secret, see README). The YouTube channel feeds need no key.

sources.name: Y Combinator company directory
sources.disabled_reason: No documented public API. YC launches are captured through 'Launch HN' posts instead.
sources.access_notes: Do not scrape.
